newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney - cold in US northeast to boost heatoil.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney - cold in US northeast to boost heatoil.

text.p: The northeastern United States will experience above average heating oil demand for at least the next two weeks as a new weather pattern could send cold spells to the region until the end of January and beyond, said Smith Barney meteorologist Jon Davis.
The U.S. Northeast is the largest heating oil market in the world.
The cold snap this weekend will send temperatures down 13 to 20 degrees below normal from Boston to Washington D.C., and will last until early next week, Davis said.
